What we do

Six ways we keep
Northland powered.

From a single power point to a full off-grid solar setup — one experienced team, start to finish.

EV Charger Installs

Home and workplace EV charging installed safely, sized to your switchboard and vehicle.

Heat Pump Installs

Reliable heating and cooling, fitted right the first time so it runs quietly for years.

Smart Vent Ventilation

Positive pressure systems pushing moist, stale air out and filtered fresh air in.

Indoor & Outdoor Lighting

Statement pendants, ambient LED strips and outdoor lighting that sets the mood.

Off-Grid & Solar

100m from the road? Solar? Three phase? We design power supply for the site you've got.

Residential & Commercial

Upgrading a house, building new, or fitting out a workplace — full electrical service.
